title: SemanticError
description: A rejection, warning or notice of the semantic engine: a stable code, its fixed severity and category, a rendered message and typed details.

Name.description: A name from the model or the query (a member, dataset, relationship, policy, unit, role). Never a data value, a secret or SQL.

Names2.description: Two names or more (a cycle repeats its first name at the end).

Count.description: An exact non-negative count, as text.

SemanticErrorCode.description: Every v1 code. Each is stable: a new code is a compatible addition; removing one or changing its meaning needs v2.

Audience.description: Who the message was rendered for. `other`, the default, gets the generic message and public details; `builder` may also see builder details. Never a data permission.
